title: Ferritin–inflammation coupling does not establish incremental hemoglobin prediction beyond flexible iron-status measures
abstract: A literature-led log-ferritin-by-log1p-CRP interaction was tested in 1282 NHANES 2015–2016 women aged20–49 not known pregnant and 1101 independently sampled 2017–2018 women. Beyond flexible iron-status measures including soluble transferrin receptor and its ferritin index, weighted RMSE changed from 0.836220 to 0.834806 g/dL; gain 0.001413 (joint PSU-bootstrap95% interval -0.001236 to 0.004696). Source cross-validation was sensitive to spline knot placement. No clear predictive benefit is established; validation is limited to independent temporal samples of one survey program, not an unrelated clinical cohort.
